battleTraits.name: EAT ’EM ALIVE
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR unit that used a FIGHT ability that targeted a unit (excluding FACTION TERRAIN and MANIFESTATIONS) this turn to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
battleTraits.effect:
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target (if any). Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that friendly OGOR unit for the rest of the battle. If any of these effects already apply to it, you can pick a different effect to replace the current effect.
• Raw and Bloody Flesh: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that unit.
• Exotic Giblets: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by that unit’s combat attacks made with non-Companion weapons.
• Steaming Brains: Add 2 to that unit’s Control characteristic.
• Crunchy Bones: That unit’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits). If that unit’s melee weapons already have Crit (2 Hits), they have Crit (Mortal) instead.
• Slick Innards: That unit can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn.
• Mystery Meat: Subtract 1 from the power level of enemy units while they are in combat with that unit, to a minimum of 0.
Designer’s Note: Only 1 of these effects can apply to the same unit at the same time unless specified otherwise. Also note that Steaming Brains affects the Control characteristic, not the control score.

battleTraits.name: JAWS OF THE BEAST
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly BEASTCLAW HERO that is leading a regiment and that has not been deployed, then pick a non-HERO unit in that HERO’s regiment that has not been deployed.
battleTraits.effect: Set up those units in reserve tracking the prey. They have now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: BULL CHARGE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit that charged this turn and has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
Your opponent must move the target up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of your units and can end that move in combat.
After your opponent has done so, roll a dice for each model in the unit using this ability that is within 3" of the target. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability is a GUTBUSTERS unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
Then, the unit using this ability can make a pile-in move. If the target of this ability is still in combat with the unit using this ability, then the target of this ability must be picked as the target of the pile-in move.
Designer’s Note: Your opponent may not be able to move the models in the target unit (or may choose to leave them where they are) but the target still counts as having moved for rules purposes.

battleTraits.name: CLOSING THE JAWS
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly BEASTCLAW HERO that is tracking the prey.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that HERO wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the other friendly unit that is tracking the prey wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 9" of that HERO and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: MASKED BY THE ENDLESS WHITE
battleTraits.effect: Friendly ALFROSTUN units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" away.

battleTraits.name: A CLAN OF HUNTERS
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly Hunters with Sabrefangs unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: The target can use the ‘Through the Frosts’ ability even if another friendly Hunters with Sabrefangs unit has used that ability this battle.

battleTraits.name: GRASP OF THE EVERWINTER
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with any friendly ALFROSTUN units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: RUN ’EM DOWN
battleTraits.effect:
Each time an enemy unit in combat with a friendly ALFROSTUN unit uses a RETREAT ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.
Designer’s Note: This mortal damage is in addition to any mortal damage inflicted on that enemy unit by that RETREAT ability.

battleTraits.name: FEARSOME BREED
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of a friendly ALFROSTUN MONSTER. Subtract 2 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of a friendly ALFROSTUN MONSTER instead.

battleTraits.name: PREPARE THE FEAST
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect: If there is no friendly Feastmaster on the battlefield, pick a friendly GOLLOP HERO to be the Feastmaster for the rest of the battle.

battleTraits.name: OOH, THAT LOOKS TASTY...
battleTraits.effect:
Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, you gain a number of raw ingredients.
The number of raw ingredients yielded by a destroyed unit is the Health characteristic of that unit multiplied by the number of starting models in that unit.
Designer’s Note: If a destroyed enemy unit had a Health characteristic of 2 and its starting size was 10 models, it would yield 20 raw ingredients when it was destroyed.

battleTraits.name: GLAND GOULASH
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, when making casting rolls and unbinding rolls for friendly GOLLOP units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster.

battleTraits.name: BONE-SLURRY SOUP
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
battleTraits.effect: Heal (D6) each friendly GOLLOP unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster.

battleTraits.name: THE ORGAN PLATTER
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the phase, while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly Feastmaster, melee weapons used by friendly GOLLOP units have Crit (Mortal).

battleTraits.name: GORE-OFFAL DUMPLINGS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect: Each friendly GOLLOP unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster can immediately use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase, but subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making the charge roll for that unit.

battleTraits.name: UNWASHED INNARDS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 4 to run rolls for friendly GOLLOP units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster.

battleTraits.name: FRIED LIMBS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 3 to charge rolls for friendly GOLLOP units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Feastmaster.

battleTraits.name: BLOODTHIRSTY ARROGANCE
battleTraits.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets a friendly MEATFIST INFANTRY unit that did not charge in the same turn, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

battleTraits.name: FLESHY STAMPEDE
battleTraits.effect: Add 2 to run rolls for friendly MEATFIST units.

battleTraits.name: MEATY CHARGE
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly MEATFIST unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this phase to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Make a meaty charge roll by rolling a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll made this turn for the unit using this ability. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability has more models than the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

battleTraits.name: THE UNSTOPPABLE FEAST
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly MEATFIST unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this battle to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability earlier in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: GLUTTONOUS CONQUERORS
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Control characteristic of friendly MEATFIST units while they are in combat.

battleTraits.name: GREEDY CHOMPERS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly MEATFIST units that are in combat to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, Heal (X) the target where X is equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: GRUESOME DEVOURERS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by a friendly MEATFIST unit’s combat attacks to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use RETREAT abilities.

battleTraits.name: TASTY MORSELS
battleTraits.effect: Each time a model is slain by a friendly Mawpit’s ‘Hungry Sinkhole’ ability, you gain 1 tasty morsel.

battleTraits.name: DRIVEN BY STARVATION
battleTraits.effect: Friendly Gorger Mawpack units can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RUN ability in the same turn unless they are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature.

battleTraits.name: TRAMPLING CHARGE
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly ROVING MAW unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTraits.name: THE REALM HUNGERS
battleTraits.effect: Units and MANIFESTATIONS are vulnerable to Mawpits while they are on the battlefield unless they are wholly within 1" of a terrain feature that is not a Mawpit. This ability has no effect on ROVING MAW units or units that have FLY.

battleTraits.name: MAWPITS OF GHUR
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.effect:
Roll 2D6 and add the number of tasty morsels you have to the roll. Apply the corresponding effect below for the rest of the battle round. Then, reset your tasty morsels to 0.
2-3 – Subdued: No effect.
4-5 – Peckish: Subtract 3 from the control scores of units that are vulnerable to Mawpits.
6-8 – Rumbling: Roll a dice for each unit that is vulnerable to Mawpits. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.
9-11 – Famished: Units that are vulnerable to Mawpits cannot use commands.
12+ – Ravenous: Roll a D3 for each unit that is vulnerable to Mawpits. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: FEAST OF BLOODSHED
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: For each enemy unit that was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit that is not in combat and has not used the ‘Power Through’ command this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.

abilities.name: PROWLING PREDATORS
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES units while they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and have not charged this turn.

abilities.name: SMASH AND GRAB
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit that charged this turn and for which the unmodified charge roll was 8+ to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was in combat with at the start of the move.

abilities.name: GRUB’S UP, MATEYS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit that has used the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability this battle to be the targets.

abilities.name: FIXATED ON FEEDING
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR INFANTRY unit that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If it ended that move in combat, the target has charged.

abilities.name: POSTPRANDIAL WARFARE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly OGOR INFANTRY units that were in combat this turn with an enemy unit that was destroyed this turn to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Return 1 slain model to each target unit.

entries.name: BLOOD FEAST
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

entries.name: SHINCRUNCHER
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, each time the target ends a move or is set up on the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after the ability has been resolved.
Designer’s Note: The ‘Bull Charge’ ability in the battle traits forces an enemy unit to move.

entries.name: TALLOWFLAGE
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away from it.

entries.name: FREEZING TAILWINDS
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target. Add 2 instead if the chanting roll was 6+.

entries.name: PULVERISING HAILSTORM
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Then, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target(s).

entries.name: FORTIFYING HOARFROST
entries.declare: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit.

entries.name: Bloodpelt Hunter

abilityDetails.name: Biggest-Game Hunter
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: The Damage characteristic of this unit’s Skullshatter Crossbow and Impaling Spear is 4 if the target is a MONSTER.

abilityDetails.name: The First Shot’s Mine
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly BEASTCLAW units that target that enemy unit.

entries.flavour: Bloodpelt Hunters seek out the largest and most formidable creatures in battle, stalking them unseen with the guile and cunning of an alpha predator. When their quarry is within reach, they close in for the kill, maiming the creature with crude iron crossbow bolts before hacking them apart with their axe and machete.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Maw Nomad.

entries.name: Butcher

abilityDetails.name: Trogg-Guts
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has WARD (6+) until the start of your next turn. If you picked a MAWSEEKERS unit, it has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn instead

abilityDetails.name: More Meat for the Pot
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit this turn by this unit’s combat attacks or by combat attacks made by a MANIFESTATION summoned by this unit, and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle.

entries.flavour: The Gulping God speaks through the blood-smeared shamans known as Butchers. Channelling the gastromantic magic of their deity, these swollen brutes can cause the very earth to come alive and munch upon their foes.
entries.regimentOptions: 0-1 %000016068Scourge of Ghyran Gnoblar Scraplauncher%, 0-1 %000025085Maw Nomad%, Any %000025090INFANTRY%
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Maw Nomad.

entries.name: Cleavers

abilityDetails.name: A Taste for the Arcane
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: If a friendly or enemy WIZARD or PRIEST is within 6" of this unit, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
• This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits).
• If this unit’s melee weapons already have Crit (2 Hits), they have Crit (Mortal).

entries.flavour: The most numerous of the Mawseekers, Cleavers are ogor zealots who have entirely given themselves to the Gulping God and his demand for mindless, cosmic consumption. They serve the Butchers by collecting bloody ‘ingredients’ for the meat-masters’ pots, empowering their primitive magics while seeking enemy mages and invokers to feast on.

entries.name: Firebelly

abilityDetails.name: Torrent of Flame
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Fire Breath if the target is INFANTRY.

entries.flavour: Wandering shamans who worship Gorkamorka as the Sun-eater, Firebellies gobble up the spiciest and deadliest ingredients to stoke the flames within their gut. Should a foe stray too close, they will be incinerated by a gout of fiery breath.
entries.regimentOptions: Any %000022683Gnoblars%, Any %000002168GUTBUSTERS%, 0-1 %000016068Scourge of Ghyran Gnoblar Scraplauncher%, 0-1 %000024977Gnoblar Scraplauncher%
entries.notes:
This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Maw Nomad.
This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Frost Sabres

abilityDetails.name: Gutless
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Bull Charge’ ability.

abilityDetails.name: Beast
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilityDetails.name: Hunters of the Frozen Wilds
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit is not visible to enemy units while it is within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.flavour: Beasts of winter, Frost Sabres bound across the landscape like shadows ghosting over the snow. Icy blood runs in their veins, and their prey seldom sees them coming until they feel the bite of the great cats’ sword-like fangs.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Frostlord on Stonehorn

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns and Hooves is 4.

abilityDetails.name: Stone Skeleton
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

abilityDetails.name: Enraged Roar
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is damaged, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Companion weapons used by other friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES units while they are within this unit’s combat range.

abilityDetails.name: Earth-shattering Charge
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the ‘Bull Charge’ ability this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target and then roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the value of the roll. It can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.

melee: Charge (+1 Damage), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: A Frostlord and their Stonehorn are an unstoppable force. The warlord’s booming voice directs the raiders while the bodies of foes are broken and ground to a bloody paste by the horns and hooves of their granite-boned steed.

entries.name: Frostlord on Thundertusk

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks is 2.

abilityDetails.name: Blessed of the Old Ice
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target can still use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT or RUN ability in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Sweeping Tusks
abilityDetails.timing: Once per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

melee: Anti-INFANTRY (+1 Rend), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: A Frostlord who rides to battle on a Thundertusk is a blizzard-cloaked warlord, a true herald of the Everwinter. The permanent aura of cold emanating from their mount has chilled the ogor’s very soul, leaving them a pitiless master of the frozen wastes.

entries.name: Gluttons

abilityDetails.name: Wall of Meat
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit if it has not charged this turn.

entries.flavour: Ogor Gluttons are hulking, muscle-bound brutes driven entirely by an unending desire for food. They thunder into battle like a landslide of sweaty flesh, taking great bites out of their foes even as they bash and hack with crude clubs and cleavers.

entries.name: Gnoblar Scraplauncher

abilityDetails.name: Rain of Scrap
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract X" from the target’s Move characteristic (to a minimum Move characteristic of 1"), where X is the number of damage points allocated to the target this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks.
Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use RUN or RETREAT abilities and cannot use or be picked to be the target of abilities that would allow it to be set up on the battlefield.

melee: Rhinox’s Sharp Horns and Crew’s Weapons

entries.flavour: The height of gnoblar ingenuity is the Scraplauncher, a catapult that hurls bucketfuls of sharp metal high into the air to rain down upon the enemy. Despite its crude construction, it is a surprisingly lethal war machine.

entries.name: Gnoblars

abilityDetails.name: Gutless
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Bull Charge’ ability.

abilityDetails.name: Nasty Traps And Tricks
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.flavour: Devious little creatures obsessed with scooping up scrap metal and other detritus, gnoblars perform a variety of tasks for their ogor masters, including charging into battle in a vast screeching mob.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Gorger Mawpack

abilityDetails.name: Troglodytic Lurkers
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
Effect: Set up this unit in reserve lurking on the fringes. It has now been deployed.

abilityDetails.name: Frenzied Hunters
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is lurking on the fringes.
Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.flavour: The Gorger Mawpacks are strange gatherings of ogors afflicted with the Empty Belly curse. Wild-eyed and starving, they launch themselves at their prey, using huge clubs or their bare hands to pulverise those unfortunate enough to be their next unsatisfying meal.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

entries.name: Gorlok Blackpowder

abilityDetails.name: Blackpowder’s Buccaneers
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit’s Peggz, Kagey, Mange and Shreek are tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its tokens next to it.

abilityDetails.name: Tiny Braggarts
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s tokens that is on the battlefield and roll a dice. On a 1, remove that token from the battlefield. On a 2+, apply its effect for the rest of the turn:
Peggz: The abilities of enemy artefacts of power that target this unit have no effect on this unit.
Kagey: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST.
Mange: Each time an unmodified hit roll for a combat attack that targets this unit is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.
Shreek: Other than the Companion

entries.flavour: The Ogor Maneater Gorlok Blackpowder made his reputation roaming the Penumbral Sea and plundering ships wherever he went, ever accompanied by a retinue of hangers-on. While the Maneater seeks out worthy adversaries to add to his boasting-tally, his crew loot everything they can get their hands, claws or beak on.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Maw Nomad.

entries.name: Great Mawpot

abilityDetails.name: Throw ’Em In
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: This Great Mawpot is either full or empty. It starts the battle full.
If an enemy model is slain within 12" of this Great Mawpot while it is empty, it becomes full.

abilityDetails.name: Battlebroth
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If the Great Mawpot is full, Heal (D3) each visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of it. After you have done so, the Great Mawpot is empty.

abilityDetails.name: Vessel of the Gulping God
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If the Great Mawpot is full, pick a visible friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD wholly within 3" of it to be the target.
Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Blessed with the strange, hungry essence of the Gulping God, the Great Mawpot is a mawtribe’s most sacred possession. All manner of ingredients are thrown into this metal cauldron and boiled up into a thick magical broth that reinvigorates any ogors who taste it.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
entries.description:
The following universal terrain abilities apply to this terrain feature (Terrain, 1.2):
Cover, Impassable

entries.name: Grell Firefist

abilityDetails.name: Ogor-Made Ammunition
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the phase:
• All of this unit’s shooting attacks must target that enemy unit.
• The Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Blastbelch is D6+2 instead of D3+2.

abilityDetails.name: Thunderous Diversion
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit that is in combat with an enemy unit that had any damage inflicted on it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
Effect: The target can immediately use a RETREAT ability as if it were your movement phase and can still use CHARGE abilities later in the turn. No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by that RETREAT ability.

abilityDetails.name: Oi! Pay Attention, Slobs!
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a %000019764command% for a %000010532visible% enemy unit within 6" of this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: You must allocate D3 damage points to another visible friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit within 3" of this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, that command has no effect and still counts as having been used, but the command points spent to use it are regained by your opponent.

entries.flavour: If there is something someone needs killing, then Grell Firefist has likely killed its kind before - and taken a bite out of it too. This veteran mercenary has travelled all over the Mortal Realms, selling her skills with her beloved cannon Blastbelch to the highest bidder. Grell keeps a fondness for her ogor kin and can usually be convinced to join a passing raid - for the right price.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Maw Nomad.

entries.name: Gutseers

abilityDetails.name: Arcane Contortions
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for visible enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.
Add 1 to casting rolls for visible friendly MAWSEEKERS WIZARDS while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Conduits of Gut Magic
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Measure the range and visibility of the next SPELL ability used by a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD that is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit from this unit instead of that WIZARD. This unit is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities or spell effects, such as ‘Unbind’.

entries.flavour: Gutseers are amongst the most unnerving acolytes of the Mawseeker cult, for they think they have perceived the infinite ravenous truth of the great god of ogorkind. Their belching chants disrupt the aether, while their bodies - bloated by the strange and vile ingredients they digest - can channel the gastromantic power of ogor shamans.

entries.name: Hrothgorn Mantrapper

abilityDetails.name: Hrothgorn’s Mantrappers
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit’s Bushwakka, Bushwakka’s Trap, Quiv, Luggit and Thwack, and Thrafnir are tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place all of its tokens except for its Bushwakka’s Trap next to it. Then, pick an objective or terrain feature and place its Bushwakka’s Trap next to it.

abilityDetails.name: Bushwakka’s Trap
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: The first time an enemy unit finishes a move within 1" of the objective or terrain feature with this unit’s Bushwakka’s Trap next to it, remove that Bushwakka’s Trap from the battlefield, then roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilityDetails.name: Hunting Beast
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit’s Thrafnir is on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 1, remove Thrafnir from the battlefield. On a 2+, place Thrafnir next to the target. Until the start of your next turn, the target is being stalked by Thrafnir. While a unit is being stalked by Thrafnir, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Trap Launcher for attacks that target that unit.

abilityDetails.name: Gnoblar Minions
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with this unit’s Trap Launcher while this unit’s Bushwakka, Quiv or Luggit and Thwack are on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of those tokens from the battlefield after the ATTACK ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

entries.flavour: Hrothgorn is a particularly foul-tempered and cruel Icebrow Hunter with a keen nose for fresh meat. He favours snaring his prey with a crossbow-launched mantrap that shatters bones with its iron jaws. Hrothgorn tolerates the constant jabbering and bickering of his Gnoblar companions only because they are useful for carrying weapons, setting traps and carrying out whatever tasks the Icebrow Hunter considers beneath him.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Maw Nomad.

entries.name: Hunters with Sabrefangs

abilityDetails.name: Through the Frosts
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. This unit cannot use MOVE abilities in the first turn of the first battle round.

abilityDetails.name: Ferocious Sabrefangs
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
Effect: Roll 2 dice for each Sabrefang in this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

entries.flavour: Hunters form the bulk of the Beastclaw alfrostuns. Each of these hardy ogors is well versed in facing down the elemental wilds and the monsters that lurk therein. They are skilled tamers and trackers, and thanks to the perpetual frosty mists that dog their steps, they can often move into position to take a satisfying crossbow shot long before the prey ever notices their presence.
entries.description:
3/5 models in this unit are Hunters and are armed with a Hunter’s Crossbow and Skinning Blades.
2/5 models in this unit are Sabrefangs and are armed with Sabrefang’s Tusks and Claws.
A Sabrefang cannot be the unit champion.

entries.name: Huskard on Stonehorn

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns and Hooves is 4.

abilityDetails.name: Stone Skeleton
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

abilityDetails.name: Primal Bellow
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target or pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. Add 2 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 4+:
• If the target is a friendly unit, its Companion weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.
• If the target is an enemy unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

ranged: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture
melee: Charge (+1 Damage), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: Many Huskard Jorls and Huskard Eurls lead their warriors from atop the backs of formidable Stonehorns. Together, the beasts and their brutish riders are master linebreakers, using their impressive strength to batter their way through all obstacles.

entries.name: Huskard on Thundertusk

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks is 2.

abilityDetails.name: Winter’s Cruelty
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the number of damage points allocated to the target by attacks made with this unit’s Ice Blast this phase, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilityDetails.name: Freezing Aura
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ranged: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture
melee: Anti-INFANTRY (+1 Rend), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: The Huskard Torr leads the Thundertusks to war. At the ogor elder’s command, the creatures breathe out gales of frost. The ground on all sides grows thick with ice as enemies are turned into gleaming statues and the very life is leeched from their bones.

entries.name: Icebrow Hunter

abilityDetails.name: Masters of Ambush
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly Frost Sabres units if those units have not been deployed.
Effect: Set up those units in reserve outflanking the prey. They have now been deployed.

abilityDetails.name: The Hunt is On
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is outflanking the prey.
Effect: Set up this unit wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each Frost Sabres unit that was set up outflanking the prey with this unit wholly within 12" of it and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.flavour: An Icebrow Hunter is a cunning stalker who utilises their surroundings to launch ambushes with the aid of their Frost Sabres. Not only do they slay opponents with spear and bolt, they also have the power to breathe a killing blizzard over their foes.
entries.notes:
This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Maw Nomad.
This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Icefall Yhetees

abilityDetails.name: Bounding Leaps
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and end that move in combat.

entries.flavour: Icefall Yhetees are savage creatures of the frozen wastelands. They appear from the howling blizzard that follows in the Beastclaw Raiders’ wake to hack apart their prey with weapons touched by magical frost.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Ironblaster

abilityDetails.name: Obliterating Blast
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of it to be the target. Then, draw a straight line between the closest points on the bases of this unit and the target. Each other unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across is a collateral damage target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on each collateral damage target.

entries.flavour: The most destructive blackpowder weapon deployed by the Gutbuster warglutts, the Ironblaster is an immense cannon that hurls solid shot into the heart of the enemy’s ranks, blasting foes into scraps of charred meat.

entries.name: Ironguts

abilityDetails.name: Personal Enforcers
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is within the combat ranges of any friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY HEROES, both this unit and those HEROES have WARD (5+).

abilityDetails.name: Displays of Might
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use the ‘Bull Charge’ ability even if another friendly unit has used it this turn.

entries.flavour: Ironguts are the meanest ogors around, the elite warriors of their warglutt. Protected by thick metal armour plates and carrying immense two-handed weapons, they wade into the thick of the fighting, hacking and bashing their foes to bloody chunks.

entries.name: Kragnos, the End of Empires

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of The Dread Mace is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

abilityDetails.name: Rampaging Destruction
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects:
• Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).

abilityDetails.name: The End of Empires
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly DESTRUCTION units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilityDetails.name: The Shield Inviolate
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per SPELL ability.

abilityDetails.name: Avatar of Destruction
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

entries.flavour: A roaring, trampling god of earthquakes and wanton destruction, Kragnos is known as the End of Empires. In his gnarled hands, the Dread Mace can shatter the walls of cities even as the shield Tuskbreaker keeps him all but inviolate.

entries.name: Leadbelchers

abilityDetails.name: Powder Gnoblars
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: This unit’s Powder Gnoblars are tokens. There are 2 Powder Gnoblars for every 4 models in this unit.
Each time this unit uses a SHOOT ability, for each of this unit’s Powder Gnoblars that are on the battlefield, you can re-roll 1 hit roll of 1 but if that attack misses, remove 1 of this unit’s Powder Gnoblars from the battlefield after that SHOOT ability has been resolved.

abilityDetails.name: Firing from the Belly
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit has not used a MOVE ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: The blackpowder-obsessed gunners known as Leadbelchers lumber into battle, blasting away with their massive guns and utilising them as makeshift bludgeons should the foe be foolish enough to engage them in hand-to-hand combat.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Maneaters

abilityDetails.name: Been There, Done That
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

entries.flavour: Maneaters are swaggering mercenaries who have travelled the realms and killed and eaten all manner of foes. Wielding a variety of esoteric weapons stolen from distant lands, they cut an imposing sight as they carve their way across the battlefield.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Mantrapper

abilityDetails.name: Mantrapper’s Accomplices
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: This unit’s Sabrefang, Gnoblars and Trap are Mantrapper accomplice tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place all its tokens next to it.
If an enemy unit is destroyed or removed from the battlefield while any of this unit’s Mantrapper accomplices are next to it, remove those Mantrapper accomplices from the battlefield.

abilityDetails.name: Just A Little Closer...
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If any of this unit’s Mantrapper accomplices are next to this unit, pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
Effect: Place 1 of this unit’s Mantrapper accomplices next to the target.

abilityDetails.name: Trapped!
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
Effect: Make a trapped roll of D6. Subtract 1 from the roll for each friendly Mantrapper accomplice next to the target. If the roll is less than the target’s Save characteristic, until the start of your next turn:
• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
• The target does not have FLY.

entries.flavour: Mantrappers are particularly irascible and cruel ogor hunters who see no issue with using various flesh-mangling traps or snare-launchers to even the odds with enemies. While they are committed loners, they inevitably accrue small gaggles of followers – ornery hunting beasts and bickering gnoblars – who are tolerated so long as they prove useful in setting, and serving as bait for, the ogor’s traps.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Maw Nomad.

entries.name: Maulbeast Cavalry

abilityDetails.name: Ravenous Counter-Attack
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Shock and Gore
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks.

entries.flavour: Maulbeast Cavalry are unleashed when a Gutbuster warlord wants something properly and thoroughly savaged. The brutish beasts these veterans ride upon are far from intelligent, but they are always hungry and up for the hunt. When such mountains of frenzied meat crash into the foe, the mess left behind must be seen to be believed.

entries.name: Maulbeast Raiders

abilityDetails.name: Relentless Predators
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is more than 9" from all enemy units, it can move up to D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

entries.flavour: Where icy winds howl, packs of Maulbeast Raiders can often be found on the hunt. These Beastclaw cavalry ride brutish quadrupeds, but they choose their specific mounts for signs of low cunning as much as ferocity. The most important trait, though, is tenacity – a quality that Maulbeasts possess in abundance, allowing their riders to keep pace with their quarry and impair them with cruel, maiming crossbow shots.

entries.name: Mawpit

abilityDetails.name: Feed the Maw
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Head Butcher, pick a friendly Butcher within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
Effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a Head Butcher (see ’Hungry Sinkhole’).
If this terrain feature is demolished, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Head Butcher. Then, set up the Head Butcher on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Head Butcher. If it is not possible to set up the Head Butcher, it is slain.

abilityDetails.name: Step Away From The Maw
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this terrain feature has a Head Butcher that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Head Butcher on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Head Butcher.

abilityDetails.name: Hungry Sinkhole
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this Mawpit to be a sinkhole. Then, you can pick another terrain feature within 12" of this Mawpit and that you have not already picked to be a sinkhole this battle to be a sinkhole for the rest of the turn.
Then, pick each enemy unit within 3" of the sinkhole(s) to be the targets.
From the second battle round onwards, increase the range at which another terrain feature can be picked to be a sinkhole by 3" for each previous battle round. If this terrain feature has a Head Butcher, increase the range at which another terrain feature can be picked to be a sinkhole by 6" for each previous battle round instead of 3".
Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.flavour: As gastromantic magic floods the battlefield, the ground itself opens hungrily in response. These Mawpits are capable only of consuming, dragging in wayward enemies to crush and digest with their many circular rows of teeth.
entries.description:
The following universal terrain abilities apply to this terrain feature (Terrain, 1.2):
Cover, Impassable

entries.name: Morga The Mighty, Overtyrant

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Grutta’s Horn and Hooves is 5

abilityDetails.name: An Ogor’s Ogor
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: More than 1 effect of the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability can apply to this unit at the same time; however, each effect can only be applied to this unit once.

abilityDetails.name: A Light Snack
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain.

abilityDetails.name: The Right Motivation
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, the following effects apply:
• While the target has not had any damage points allocated to it this phase, each time the unmodified hit roll for a combat attack that targets it is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.
• If the target has had any damage points allocated to it this phase, add 1 to the Att

abilityDetails.name: Been There, Ate That
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:
• If any enemy non-MONSTER models were slain by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, Heal (D3) this unit.
• If any damage points were allocated to an enemy MONSTER unit by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy MONSTER has been destroyed, Heal (D3+3) this unit.

melee: Charge (+1 Damage), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: Morga the Mighty is the Overtyrant of the Meatfist and the most fearsome ogor warlord alive. Though named the champion of the Gulping God by the Butchers, the truth is she has little interest in spiritual matters. Conquest and consumption alone enthuse this brutish matriarch, and she will use any method – be it inspirational acts of gluttony, canny promises of plunder or good-old fashioned extreme violence – to motivate her hordes to deliver it.

entries.name: Mournfang Pack

abilityDetails.name: Alpha Cavalry
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: The Charge (+1 Damage) weapon ability has no effect on attacks that target this unit.

entries.flavour: Ogors mounted on Mournfangs wield clubs, blades and pistols, firing point-blank into their foes before laying about them with brutal abandon. Their foultempered beasts trample and gore anything that gets in their way.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Redd the Maw, High Slaughtermaster

abilities: From the Depths of the Cauldron

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mawseeker Acolytes’ Blades and Gorger’s Claws is 5.

abilityDetails.name: Son of the Hungering One
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit:
• Friendly non-MAWSEEKERS OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY units have WARD (6+).
• Friendly MAWSEEKERS units have WARD (5+).

abilityDetails.name: From the Depths of the Cauldron
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly NON-HERO OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability as if it were the end of the turn and it were eligible to do so.

abilityDetails.name: The Maw Opens
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: If the target is not in combat, it can move up to D3+3" but must end that move no further from the nearest enemy unit that is visible to it. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
If the target is in combat, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target, then Heal (D3) the target. If the

melee: Mawseeker Acolytes’ Blades and Gorger’s Claws

entries.flavour: To the ogors, Redd the Maw is a prophet – one who has been favoured to glimpse their monstrous god. To outsiders, he is a blood-caked avatar of primeval terror. Following an odyssey into deepest Shyish, Redd’s proficiency with gut magic has grown great indeed, but it is power of a base and bestial sort, for ogors who breathe in the vapours of his cauldron are overcome with a frothing, gluttonous frenzy.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Frostlord on Thundertusk

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks is 2.

abilityDetails.name: Snow Plough
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use CHARGE abilities this turn even if it is in combat. If the charge roll is 2 or less when it does so, it does not count as having charged.

abilityDetails.name: Cold Fury
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared the ‘%000024072Eruption of Fury%’ ability for this unit
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: When resolving attacks as part of that ability:
• For each unmodified hit roll of 6, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with this unit instead of D3.
• For each unmodified hit roll of 1, allocate 1 mortal damage to this unit instead of D3 (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

melee: Anti-INFANTRY (+1 Rend), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: The frigid aura that emanates from a Thundertusk cannot be quelled even by the arid climes of the Aqshian deserts, and Frostlord warleaders who ride upon these mammoth-like mounts have a particular connection to the eldritch Everwinter.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Huskard on Thundertusk

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks is 2.

abilityDetails.name: Everwinter’s Ire
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• While your opponent’s fury level is equal to or up to 2 levels below your fury level, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.
• While your opponent’s fury level is 3 or more levels below your fury level, add 2 to chanting rolls for this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Cool Tempers
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is wholly outside friendly territory and not in combat, your opponent must reduce their fury level by 1, to a minimum of 0.

melee: Anti-INFANTRY (+1 Rend), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: Said to have been chosen by the Everwinter itself, a Huskard Torr always rides a Thundertusk, possessing a natural affinity with the icewreathed beast. As they journey across the Great Parch, the pair channel the magical blizzard to see the realm’s elemental fury quenched.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Voice of the Everwinter. This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.
entries.description:
This unit is armed with an Ice Blast, Punches and Kicks, Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks, and 1 of the following options:
• Chaintrap
• Harpoon Launcher
• Blood Vulture

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Gnoblar Scraplauncher

abilityDetails.name: Scrap Away!
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. In addition, on a 5+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

melee: Rhinox’s Sharp Horns and Crew’s Weapons

entries.flavour: Gnoblars prefer stuffing their ramshackle Scraplauncher catapults with scraps of iron and broken blades, but in Ghyran, they have learnt that shards of splintered wood, poisonous fungi and bloodwasp nests are just as lethal. They blindly lob this ammunition towards the enemy, chortling evilly when they hear the telltale screams of a barrage hitting home.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Ironblaster

abilityDetails.name: Shrapnel Blast
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: For the rest of the phase:
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons.
• This unit’s ranged weapons have Crit (2 Hits).

entries.flavour: The massive cannons known as Ironblasters must be hauled into battle by snorting rhinoxen and are unsurprisingly ill-suited to the close confines of the Ghyranite forests. Ogor gunners have instead resorted to stuffing the weapons’ gaping barrels with fistfuls of iron, ironwood splinters and whatever else they can grab, firing this lethal payload point-blank into the faces of ambushing foes.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Slaughtermaster

abilityDetails.name: Fill the Pot
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit’s cauldron is either filled with grisly remains or empty. It starts the battle empty. If an enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn is destroyed and this unit’s cauldron is empty, it becomes filled with grisly remains.

abilityDetails.name: Great Cauldron
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit’s cauldron is filled with grisly remains, pick a visible friendly MAWSEEKERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: This unit’s cauldron is now empty. Pick 1 of the following effects:
Bloodgruel: The target has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.
Spinemarrow: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Slaughtermasters have entirely lost themselves to their cravings, hacking off their limbs and replacing them with rusty hooks and blades. They drag a cookpot into battle behind them so that they may boil up a tasty broth even as they slice up their prey.
entries.notes:
This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Maw Nomad.
This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Stonehorn Beastriders

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns and Hooves is 4.

abilityDetails.name: Stone Skeleton
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

abilityDetails.name: Stonehorn Avalanche
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the ‘Bull Charge’ ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit or an enemy faction terrain feature within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• If the target is a unit, inflict 3 mortal damage on it.
• If the target is a faction terrain feature, inflict 6 mortal damage on it.

ranged: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture
melee: Charge (+1 Damage), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: The ground shakes under a Stonehorn’s headlong charge, each footfall a toll of doom. From its back, a pair of Beastriders bring down foes with snapping chaintraps and harpoons, hauling in their kills to add to the mawtribe’s meat harvest.

entries.name: Thundertusk Beastriders

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks is 2.

abilityDetails.name: Plough the Icepath
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for this unit in your %000009719movement% phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY unit that has not been reinforced, is wholly within 6" of this unit and has not been set up this turn to be the target. Remove the target from the battlefield. After this unit ends its move, you must set up the target unit wholly within 6" of this unit and not in combat. The target cannot use CHARGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Chilling Onslaught
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks.

ranged: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture
melee: Anti-INFANTRY (+1 Rend), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: The Everwinter clings to the Thundertusks and follows them wherever they tread, the air around them thick with glimmering frost. Guided into battle by a pair of savage Beastriders, these mammoth beasts smash and grind their prey to bloody ruin.

entries.name: Tyrant

abilityDetails.name: Big Name
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle. You cannot pick an effect that has already been picked for another friendly Tyrant.
• Neck-wringer: Enemy INFANTRY units that have a Health characteristic of 1 or 2 cannot contest objectives while they are in combat with this unit.
• Steed-eater: Enemy CAVALRY units cannot use RETREAT abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
• Giant-wrestler: Enemy MONSTERS cannot use RAMPAGE abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Brawlerguts
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You delcared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a visible friendly non-HERO OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: The ferocious warleaders of the Gutbuster warglutts, Tyrants are living mountains of iron and blubbery flesh. Despite their girth, they move with surprising speed, hacking their prey into bloody chunks for easier consumption.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Maw Nomad.

entries.name: Tyrant on Glutthorn

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Glutthorn’s Horn and Hooves is 5.

abilityDetails.name: Pitiless Warlord
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for an %000002211OGOR MAWTRIBES% unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Re-roll 1 dice in that charge roll.

abilityDetails.name: Glutthorn Stampede
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is INFANTRY. On a 4+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

melee: Charge (+1 Damage), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: Tyrants who really want to impress with size and status require a suitable mount, and few are seen as more suitable than the glutthorns. Bulky and bad-tempered, these beasts shake the earth with every step, snorting in simple annoyance at suffering apparently grievous wounds, while the Tyrant crushes skulls and bellows for tardy underlings to start pulling their weight.
